mods.name: SULFUR Multiplayer
mods.summary: Online co-op for 2–8 players. Fight the same enemies, share the loot and drop into each other's levels through Steam.
mods.description:
SULFUR Multiplayer lets you and your friends play SULFUR together. One player loads their save and hosts from the F8 menu, and everyone else joins through Steam (an invite, or "Join Game" in the friends list) — no IP addresses or port forwarding. Joiners drop straight into the host's level and follow them from level to level. Enemies are run by the host's game and go after every player, and loot, chests, doors, breakables and loose physics objects are shared. Other players show up as goblins holding whatever weapon they have out. Everyone keeps their own character, inventory and save.

The zip contains an installer (SulfurMP-Setup.exe) that finds your SULFUR folder and sets everything up, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Everyone needs the same version.
details: 2–8 players, joined through Steam invites or "Join Game" (no port forwarding)
Shared enemies, loot, chests, doors, breakables and physics objects
Friends drop into the host's level and follow them automatically
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 0.3.0: first public build. Steam lobbies for 2–8 players, shared enemies, loot, doors and physics objects, other players shown as goblins with their weapons, and automatic drop-in when the host changes level. Everyone must have the same version.

mods.name: Noita Multiplayer
mods.summary: Two-player online co-op in one shared, fully synced Noita world. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
Noita Multiplayer puts you and a friend in the same world at the same time: terrain, liquids, fire, enemies, items, physics objects, spells, perks, orbs and hearts are all synced. Pick "Co-op: Host" or "Co-op: Join" in the New Game menu, or invite your friend through Steam and their game loads your world by itself. If you die while your partner is alive you go down instead, and they can revive you.

The zip contains an installer (NoitaCoop_Installer.exe) that sets everything up, the raw mod folders if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Both players need the same version.
details: Shared world: terrain, water, fire, enemies, items and physics props stay in sync
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding) or by direct IP
Downed & revive, shared perks, orbs and hearts
Installer exe + raw mod folders + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 1.3.0: fixed ghost enemies (only visible to one player, or unkillable), fixed enemies spawning doubled inside each other, burning terrain and props now sync, water/liquids are re-checked and repaired much faster. Both players must update (1.2.0 can't connect to 1.3.0).

mods.name: FTL: Faster Than Light Multiplayer
mods.summary: Crew one ship together—online co-op for up to 8 players, each controlling one crew member. Join through Steam or by IP.
mods.description:
FTL Co-op puts up to 8 players on the same ship. Each player controls one crew member and runs the controls of the room they're standing in: the pilot handles power, jumps and the star map, the gunner aims and fires, and the doors, drones, teleporter, cloaking, hacking and mind control each belong to whoever mans that room. Crew nobody controls are run by a smarter AI that mans stations, repairs, fights fires and boarders and heads to the medbay when hurt. Invite a Steam friend from FTL's main menu (no port forwarding), or join by IP.

The zip contains an installer (FTL-Coop-Install.exe) that rolls FTL back to 1.6.9 and sets everything up, the raw mod files if you'd rather install it yourself, and a README explaining both. Everyone needs the same version.
details: Up to 8 players share one ship, one crew member each
Room-based controls: piloting, weapons, drones, doors and more
Join through Steam invites (no port forwarding) or by direct IP
Installer exe + raw mod files + README in one zip
mods.changelog: 11.0.0: first public build (co-op mod version 11). Up to 8 players, Steam invites or IP, join or leave mid-run, vote to save and quit, smarter AI crew for unclaimed crew members. Needs FTL 1.6.9 - the installer rolls it back for you.
